Severity levels:
critical: would change patient management.
major: would need an amended report.
minor: internal inconsistency without clinical consequence.

Error types:
H1 — Gross–microscopic mismatch: size, number, laterality or site in the gross contradicted in microscopy or synoptic. Default severity: major.
H2 — Diagnosis unsupported by morphology: microscopic description does not support the stated diagnosis or grade. Default severity: critical.
H3 — Staging inconsistency: pT/pN contradicts reported size, depth of invasion or node findings. Default severity: critical.
H4 — Node arithmetic error: positive nodes exceed total, or text and synoptic counts differ. Default severity: major.
H5 — Required element missing or contradictory: margins, LVI or PNI absent, or margin status contradicts the description. Default severity: major or minor.
H6 — IHC–diagnosis inconsistency: immunoprofile contradicts the diagnosis. Default severity: critical.
